## About
Valley Plumbing Home Center is a local, family-owned plumbing company on Rose Ave in Pleasanton. We've grown into a corporation, but we've kept the same family feeling. Our motto, "Integrity Before Profit," guides us in hiring people who care about their work.
We're a licensed, insured and bonded company with licenses in plumbing and general contracting, so we can handle a repair or coordinate a whole bathroom remodel. We serve homeowners, property managers, insurance adjusters and commercial businesses across the Tri-Valley.
Our showroom has faucets, showerheads, toilets, vanities and shower fixtures on display, and we can place special orders with all reputable companies. Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 510 Google reviews.

## Services
- Toilet, shower & sink clogs: Clogged toilets, showers and sinks cleared and running again.
- Main line stoppages: When the main line backs up, we find the stoppage and clear it.
- Earthquake shut-off valves: Shut-off valves for homes here in earthquake country.
- Pipe & drain repair: Repairs for broken, leaking or worn pipes and drains.
- Gas line installation & repair: New gas lines put in and existing lines repaired.
- Water heater installation & repair: One reviewer said Carl came out, confirmed the leak, and installed a new water heater in a tight spot, leaving it very clean.
- Tankless water heater installation & repair: Installation and repair for tankless water heaters.
- Bathroom remodels: Anything from updating plumbing fixtures to an entire new look. We start once all materials have arrived, so there's no down time.

## FAQ
Q: Can I reach you outside normal hours?
A: Yes. Call 925-462-1639 to schedule service. We offer 24-hour service, 365 days available.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Normal service hours are Monday – Friday, 6:30 a.m. to 4:15 p.m. The showroom is open Monday – Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Fill out the short form or call 925-462-1639 to schedule an appointment for a free estimate on your upcoming project.

Q: When does a remodel start?
A: Our policy is to start a remodel once all materials have arrived. That way there's no down time once the work begins.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Pleasanton and serve Fremont, Dublin, Danville, Livermore, Walnut Creek, San Ramon, the East Bay and the Bay Area.
